description: This PHP source file defines the SesV2Client class within the Aws\SesV2 namespace. The class extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) V2 API, including operations related to email configuration, sending emails, managing contacts, and retrieving metrics.

classes.name: SesV2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon SES V2 service, offering methods to perform various email-related operations and configurations.
